items.html: And the Hei of Elokim of Daat: its form is Vav-Vav-Vav, in three lines. And it is the aspect of ZA in this Mochin, for he has already been born and emerged. Then the Hei of the Bina of Daat expands within him in the secret of the three lines, which are its NHY, as is known, in order to make Mochin in the ZA that is there, in the Daat. Also another reason, on account of the Daat itself, whose form is a Vav, as above. Also another reason, on account of ZA himself, who is also called Vav. Behold, for three reasons — which are in Bina, in Daat, and in ZA, all of which are aspects within the Mochin of Daat — therefore this Hei was formed in the form of Vav-Vav-Vav.
